meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: Claude 会以编排者身份先派子代理做文档调研(Phase 0),再产出可分阶段、能在新会话中连续执行的实施计划;每个实施阶段都带文档引用、验证清单和反模式提醒,最后一阶段做验证。
howto.when: 当你要求规划一个功能、任务或多步实施时触发,尤其在使用 do 执行之前。

say.text: 帮我把「用户登录改造」规划成分阶段实施方案
say.note: 会先做文档调研,再分层输出

say.text: 先做文档调研,列出可用的 API 和签名
say.note: 产出 Phase 0 的 Allowed APIs 清单

say.text: 给每个阶段加上验证清单和反模式提醒
say.note: 每阶段附测试或 grep 验证步骤

howto.what_en: Claude acts as orchestrator: it first sends subagents to discover docs (Phase 0), then writes a phased plan runnable across new chat contexts, with doc references, verification checklists and anti-pattern guards per phase.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation, especially before executing with do.

say_en.text: Plan the "user login refactor" as a phased implementation plan
say_en.note: Starts with docs discovery, then phases

say_en.text: Do the documentation discovery first and list the allowed APIs
say_en.note: Returns a Phase 0 allowed-API list with sources

say_en.text: Add a verification checklist and anti-pattern guards to each phase
say_en.note: Each phase ends with proof steps
